CheckTitle: Network ACLs allow access to SSH port (22) from the internet
Description: Network ACLs found with port 22 open to the internet.
Risk: SSH (port 22) is the standard port for Secure Shell access, used for secure remote administration of Unix/Linux systems. Exposing SSH to the internet (0.0.0.0/0) creates a direct attack surface for brute-force attempts and credential theft, potentially allowing unauthorized system access and control.

Recommendation.Text: Ensure ingress access to ports from the internet is limited, unless required by business requirements.
